intro: One playthrough can earn all 55 trophies: the game has no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals, and everything outside the story stays available after the credits. Published guides estimate roughly 200 hours for the Platinum, most of it in the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. The order below is built from the official trophy descriptions — which chapters and missions they name, which collectibles and counts they ask for — with the reported details cited to their sources.

missables.text: Of the 18 meditation spots, one is Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, available only during Chapter 1. The published guides agree it disappears when the chapter ends and that no other trophy on the list is missable: the 12 story trophies cannot be missed, and everything else stays available after the credits. Do the balcony spot in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
missables.title: Positive Mental Attitude — the one true missable

saveRules.text: GTA VI has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. The game offers 15 manual save slots plus an autosave: park one save at the start of each of the five chapters and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest.
saveRules.title: Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter

saveRules.text: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 ends. It is the one missable the published guides agree on. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep that chapter's save until the trophy pops.
saveRules.title: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends

saveRules.text: The timed street race in Yago's strand (Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass) counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first, then race it while it is on the table.
saveRules.title: Run Yago's timed race when it appears in Chapter 3

saveRules.text: Cheats are reported to switch off trophies and saving for the session. Keep your Platinum save cheat-free.
saveRules.title: Never use cheats on a trophy run

sources.name: Exophase

sources.name: PSNProfiles

sources.name: Output Lag

sources.name: HowToVideoGame

sources.name: GTA Vibes

sources.name: GTA Spotter

sources.name: Techtroduce

stages.summary: Open the story, and before Chapter 1 closes, take Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house: it is one of the 18 spots Positive Mental Attitude counts, and it is gone for good once the chapter ends. Park a manual save at the chapter's start.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — and the one missable

stages.summary: Play the main story to the end. All 12 story trophies are unmissable and land as you finish chapters and named missions; the Gold is the final mission itself. Character switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, which unlocks the partner trophies, and bank vaults open near the end of Chapter 4.
stages.title: Chapters 2 to 5 — the story spine

stages.summary: Finish the named characters' strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in their own trophy, and Bret's hunting questline ends in Fair Game. Then complete any 8 counting strands for Strangers & Freaks — remembering that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward it, while Yago's timed Chapter 3 race does.
stages.title: The people of Leonida — side stories

stages.summary: Sample all 9 activity types for Master of None, then go deep: 42 Shooting Range golds, a drone race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, 50 Challenges and 250 stunts. The one-off feats — the airliner at VCIA, the Rhino tank, the showroom escape, the gym, the bowling alley — can be picked off whenever you are nearby, most of them in minutes.
stages.title: Activities and one-off feats

stages.summary: The robbery ladder: one undetected jewelry store, 5 bank vaults (bring your partner — escaping a vault's 4-star heat with them also earns Hot Together), an armored truck, 3 shops back-to-back under one Wanted Level, and one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Money follows: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages, then register 10 cars to Scooter Bros.
stages.title: Crime and money

stages.summary: The long sweeps, best done region by region while the rest of the list progresses: finish the remaining meditation spots, complete 3 Collectible Card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles (WAiNK scans count), and visit every area of Leonida.
stages.title: Collections and the map

stages.summary: After the credits, the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and earlier work counts toward it. Its bars overshoot the trophy minimums — 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 vehicles, all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations — so close those gaps, take A Long Road, and Vice Got a Price! follows immediately as the 55th trophy.
stages.title: 100% Completion — and the Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
